_about: Instruction injection index (planning/Explainers Cost/INJECTION-PLAN.md, approved 2026-11-16). Every `## ` section of the builder stack has one entry. tier: core = always in every builder's system prompt (the shared, cached prefix); pick = Jev decides per context window whether to inject it; ref = never injected, Read on demand only. summary = what Jev reads to decide. A section missing here fails tests/explainers-injection.test.ts.

craft:intro.summary: What the craft file is and how to use it.

craft:1-cinematography.summary: Framing, shot sizes, camera angles and camera moves: how each shot is composed and why.

craft:2-lighting.summary: Key, fill and rim light, mood and colour temperature of a place.

craft:3-editing.summary: Cuts between shots: when to cut, match cuts, continuity, avoiding jump cuts, rhythm.

craft:4-storyboarding.summary: Reading and following a storyboard: beats, shots and what each must show.

craft:5-animation.summary: Animation principles: timing, easing, anticipation, follow-through, staging of action.

craft:6-explainer-craft-and-mayer.summary: Explainer learning principles (Mayer): signalling, one idea at a time, words matched to pictures.

craft:7-script-and-voiceover.summary: Writing the script and voiceover lines (the director's job, not a builder's).

craft:8-production-design.summary: Designing places and sets: believable rooms and exteriors, set dressing, scale, depth.

craft:9-character-and-prop-design.summary: Designing characters (critters) and props: silhouettes, readability, consistency across frames.

craft:10-information-design.summary: Showing how a real mechanism works: diagrams, flows, before/after, split, combine, change of state.

craft:11-sound.summary: Sound design: event-timed foley, paper and pen sounds, hits on cuts, music bed.

house-style:intro.summary: What the house style file covers.

house-style:palette-and-orange.summary: The palette and where orange may be used.

house-style:mechanism-frames.summary: House rules for frames that show the real mechanism.

house-style:heroes-critters-and-objects.summary: House rules for the hero, critters and objects.

house-style:critter-roles.summary: Critter roles and how they are dressed.

house-style:the-analogy-frame.summary: House rules for the analogy world frames.

minimums:the-eight-minimums.summary: The eight minimums every frame meets.

minimums:fail-open.summary: What to do when a minimum cannot be met.

frame:what-the-kit-builds.summary: Which frames and parts the kit builds by code.

frame:the-frame-module.summary: The frame module's exports and shape.

frame:cameras-and-shots.summary: Declaring shots and cameras in a frame module: lens camera, shot list, moves between shots.

frame:the-world-module.summary: The world module (world.js): places, cast, views, what the scene builder writes and frames import.

frame:places.summary: Building places (interiors, exteriors, journeys) in the world and standing things in them.

frame:the-analogy-room.summary: The analogy's main room: how the analogy world is laid out and reused.

frame:light-and-mood.summary: Light and mood per place and per shot in code.

frame:critters.summary: Placing and animating critters in a frame: poses, gestures, walking, looking, holding.

frame:roles.summary: Critter roles in code: outfits and items for a role.

frame:objects-and-the-courier.summary: Objects, props and the courier that carries things between places; drawing new objects (NEW_PROPS).

frame:carry.summary: A critter carrying or handing over an object.

frame:solids-labels-and-drawing.summary: Solid shapes, labels on things and freehand drawing primitives.

frame:mechanism-primitives.summary: Primitives for the real mechanism: devices, flows, tokens, arrows, glass screens, diagrams.

frame:sound-events.summary: Writing the frame's sound events file (.events.json): timed foley and hits.

kit:core-js.summary: core.js: the math every shot stands on.

kit:motion-js.summary: motion.js: timing helpers and the frame loop.

kit:lens-js.summary: lens.js: the perspective camera, depth, parallax and camera moves through the world.

kit:light-js.summary: light.js: animated light, light as motion, light pools and changes over time.

kit:set-js.summary: set.js: set design, walkable places, rooms, exteriors and set dressing.

kit:shots-js.summary: shots.js: shot declarations, a shot as a camera, cuts and shot timing.

kit:cast-js.summary: cast.js: the critter API, bodies, poses, gestures, walking and looks.

kit:animals-js.summary: animals.js: real animals (dog, cat, bird...) drawn in the kit's style.

kit:outfits-js.summary: outfits.js: critter outfits, head pieces and held items by role.

kit:space-js.summary: space.js: one room or space, its floor, walls and depth.

kit:objects-js.summary: objects.js: the real things a mechanism moves, and their motion (travel, split, combine, change state).

kit:connect-js.summary: connect.js: cables plugged in at both ends between devices.

kit:setlock-js.summary: setlock.js: the locked set, keeping each place's things fixed across shots.

kit:glass-js.summary: glass.js: glass and gloss for real-tech frames: screens, panels, devices.

kit:layout-js.summary: layout.js: UI spacing, keeping icons, numbers and labels apart.

kit:explain-js.summary: explain.js: visual explanation and diagrams for the mechanism, concept identity.

kit:cards-js.summary: cards.js: cards with text on them, glass cards, the dictionary card.

kit:props-js.summary: props.js: the prop asset bank, using bank props and drawing new ones.

kit:seams-js.summary: seams.js: how a shot leaves and the next arrives, transitions between shots.

kit:mark-js.summary: mark.js: the Helios logo landing after the payoff.

kit:close-js.summary: close.js: the close frame, built by code (never by a builder).

kit:examples-js.summary: examples.js: finished example objects built from the drawing primitives.
